relationships.evidence_quote: KCC2 is particularly susceptible to calpains (as illustrated in Figure 2A), which results in functional impairment and, as a result, a decrease in inhibitory control

relationships.subject: Calpain
relationships.evidence_quote: They have the ability to cleave ankyrin G, which leads to the dissolution of the AIS scaffold and the relocation or loss of ion channels

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: In the hippocampus, BDNF activates calpain-2 through the TrkB and ERK/MAPK signaling pathways

relationships.subject: NMDA receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: As calcium enters through NMDA receptors, calpains proteolyze target neuronal substrates including cytoskeletal proteins such as spectrin

relationships.subject: NMDA receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: calcium influx is facilitated by NMDA receptors, which subsequently activate a number of downstream kinases, including CaMKII, PKC, and ERK

key_findings: Review: calpains are essential regulators of spinal synaptic and intrinsic plasticity but drive pathology (spasticity, neuropathic pain) when hyperactivated, in part by cleaving KCC2, ankyrin G and ion channels.
BDNF-TrkB and calpain crosstalk may support spinal plasticity; direct spinal evidence remains lacking.
